skill.summary: AI chibi maker — convert a photo into a cute chibi character sticker

latestVersion.changelog:
chibi-maker-openapi-skill 1.0.0

- Initial release of the chibi-maker skill.
- Converts a user-provided photo into a cute chibi character sticker.
- Requires a WeShop API key and HTTPS access to openapi.weshop.ai.
- Defines endpoints for starting photo-to-chibi runs, polling status, and uploading images.
- Includes detailed usage, API key security instructions, and input field documentation.
